title: Explicit power scalar for a finite purity source chart
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting and use the root charts of [def-pur-finite-reduction-root-charts]. Let d,c be natural numbers and let zeta,zeta_prime be primitive P.diagonalExponent-th roots in the base field with zeta = zeta_prime^c. For every base-field scheme X, scheme Y, map f:X→Y and unbounded intrinsic derived coefficient object K on Y, the hom of finiteReductionSourceTrivialization at zeta_prime equals c^d times its hom at zeta. Multiplication is repeated addition of the morphism. No geometric finiteness or boundedness is required.

source.place: Step 2: compatibility with invertible twists by tensor associativity; expansion of the specified normalized primitive-root charts.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary root-line inverse-chart power relation, then map it through the degree-zero single-complex and shift functors.

For the actual ordered tensor recursion, induct on d. The zero term is independent of the root. At a successor, additivity in both tensor variables multiplies the scalar from the previous term by c, giving c^(d+1). The fixed unit and reassociation factors do not change. Exact comparison inverse image carries this equation to the pro-etale power chart. Tensoring with the arbitrary pulled-back complex, the fixed scalar-unit factors, intrinsic realization and the shift comparison preserve the same natural-number scalar. This gives the displayed hom equation.

proof_origin.source: Explicit normalized root-section calculation and induction on the existing ordered tensor recursion, expanding finite-reduction proof Step 2.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteReductionSourceTrivialization_power (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (d c : ℕ) (ζ ζ' : P.field.k)
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ P.diagonalExponent)
    (hζ' : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ' P.diagonalExponent) (hc : ζ = ζ' ^ c)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (K : Scheme.proEtaleDerivedCategory Y P.Ring) :
    (P.finiteReductionSourceTrivialization f d ζ' hζ' K).hom =
      c ^ d • (P.finiteReductionSourceTrivialization f d ζ hζ K).hom
